bush142.expected: Net on, ally isolated: project v1 idle foliage 0.20 and direct sight, project v2 idle foliage 0.40 and hidden, v2 after accepted target shot foliage 0.25 and direct sight. Predicted before Jolt settling.

assist6.expected: With the WZ net active, shooter direct is expected false; two allied direct spotters are expected true. Actual settling, aim, ballistic hit, damage, and assist split are NOT_RUN. The projectile and terrain clearance are sampled/bounds estimates only.

method.terrain: pinned 769x769 terrain mesh, source triangle interpolation, 240 samples per ray; not exact triangle intersection
method.rays: 2x7 P07B source points, yaw observer=pi target=0, pitch=roll=0, gun yaw=0; settled physical angles unknown
method.static: 3D projectile instance AABB intersections and 4 m physical AABB clearance at spawns; no dynamic objects
method.foliage: pinned project-calibrated affine ellipsoids, not original leaf geometry
method.ally: center-to-center dry terrain sample and obstacle AABB only; actual bot scan not observed
method.note: network and fire outcomes must be checked via committed server trace; team publication may remain true when own direct is false

expected_inferred.field180_net_on: base threshold 190.6m; direct LOS candidate, usually early return after first clear ray
expected_inferred.bush180_net_on: base threshold 190.6m, foliage-adjusted 152.6m; 14/14 predicted foliage intersections and no direct sight
expected_inferred.bush180_net_off: base threshold 209.6m, foliage-adjusted 171.6m; 14/14 predicted foliage intersections and no direct sight
expected_inferred.bush180_after_fire: for a hit within 15m, effect 0.20*0.25; net-on effective camo 0.26*0.25+0.05=0.115, threshold 218.15m; first clear ray may make direct sight true
expected_inferred.isolated_ally: ally farther than max detection 445m from target; team-shared retention may expire after 5s if no other active allied observer sees it
expected_inferred.team_ally: ally within ~135m and view 390m can share target if its own actual LOS is clear
expected_inferred.field200_movement: light tank moving base equals still in this calibration; with a net, actual committed movement/turn resets net and temporarily increases range from 190.6m to 209.6m; without net it does not demonstrate a movement-only penalty

scripted_cycle.interpretation: relative to first Battle tick; read accepted outcomes and committed physical poses; approximate 12–13s forward, 24–25s turning and 36s fire; leave >=3s for net and >=5s for retention

assist_shot.description: test_lab only; server takes aim point from committed target pose, requires committed team visibility and shooter direct=false both at aim and fire; actual ballistic damage NOT_RUN

bush_shot.description: Only the stationary bush142 target fires. Capture direct sight and each ray's foliage before, during and after the authoritative shot window.
